method.height_seed: Original B20 H4 relative terrain, not true elevation
method.rounding: round to 0.01 index units and clamp to [0,100]
method.shoreline_outlets: All shoreline cells defined by at least one missing 4-neighbor (157), original coastal heights untouched
method.spill_level: For each land cell, minimax path of highest sampled elevation along an 8-neighbor path to any coastal outlet; use lexicographic priority flood from shore to inland
method.core_screen: distance from coast >=3, depression fill depth >=3, connected 8-neighbor core >=4
method.expanded_pocket: core 8-neighbor-extended to connected positive-fill cells, shore distance >=2 and same spill threshold. These have merely topographic storage potential, not guaranteed lake water.

S1.name: 挤压造山与山前沉积
S1.intent: 增设倾斜隆起轴与局部山前低位；只是空间假说

S2.name: 张裂断块与构造凹陷
S2.intent: 中心局部沉降、两侧抬升肩部

S3.name: 古老高地侵蚀与谷地切割
S3.intent: 沿试验弯曲谷轴降低相对高度

limitations: Every H4 scenario is an alternate worldbuilding trial, no scenario is the real H4 terrain
No actual lake water balance, tectonic chronology, lithology, real grid size or square kilometers
Gridcell*height capacity index and relative water stage cannot be converted to water mass or metric depth
No state names, coast edits, continent coordinates, named faults or official rivers added
A depression holds water below the spill threshold only if adequate supply and permeability support it; permanent surface water requires season-resolved water budget
